ru.headline: В субботу он смотрел в глаза
ru.body: и строил планы на осень. Во вторник — сухое «занят» и три дня тишины.

en.headline: On Saturday he looked into your eyes
en.body: and talked about trips together. By Tuesday — a dry "busy" and 3 days of cold silence.

per_panel_scene_hints.scene: Victoria in-scene (face+hair from victoria-sheet only) in a NEW deep burgundy merino turtleneck and gold hoops, seated three-quarter, looking at a glowing phone that holds Saturday warmth vs a dry Tuesday «занят». A cat sits in the scene as intuition — sensing the temperature drop. Magenta handwritten script «Тепло – холодно» / «Hot & Cold» secondary. Huge white scene headline. Warm gold rim vs cold screen glow. No word Сцена. Motion-safe: static type, one hero, one animal.

ru.headline: Ты ищешь, где ошиблась
ru.body: Перечитываешь переписку. Пугает не пауза, а перепад: от полного тепла до ледяной стены.

en.headline: Searching for what you did wrong
en.body: You scroll through messages. The silence hurts, but the brutal temperature drop hurts worse.

per_panel_scene_hints.scene: Type-dominant panel. A loyal dog waits beside a glowing phone / chat thread — loyalty to the unanswered question. No Victoria. Temperature drop as the pain, not a generic pause vibe.

ru.headline: Ловушка — греть сквозняк
ru.body: Думаешь: «он испугался чувств». Начинаешь проявлять заботу в ответ на холод, закрепляя качели.

en.headline: The trap of warming his draft
en.body: You think: "he's scared of his feelings." You respond to distance with double the warmth, fueling the cycle.

per_panel_scene_hints.scene: No animal. Bold white headline. Magenta torn-tape pills that cancel the excuse «он испугался чувств» / "he's scared of his feelings". Draft / cold-air motif as graphic, not a weather meme.

ru.headline: Прерывистое подкрепление
ru.body: Непредсказуемость держит нервную систему в напряжении. Мозг путает тревогу с сильной любовью.

en.headline: Intermittent reinforcement
en.body: Unpredictability spikes your nervous system. Your brain confuses chronic anxiety with genuine passion.

per_panel_scene_hints.scene: Owl as night thoughts piercing the hidden loop. Small mechanism diagram or magenta pills for 'unpredictable reward'. No horror. Type 50–60%, owl at side/bottom inside the scene.

ru.headline: Тепло vs Холод: две фазы
lines: Тепло: ему нужен твой ресурс и внимание

en.headline: Warm vs Cold: two phases
lines: Warm: craving your energy, validation, and attention
Cold: retreating the moment consistency is required

per_panel_scene_hints.scene: SAVE CARD. Full framed card / table inside the panel. Two columns: Тепло / Warm vs Холод / Cold. Magenta rules and pills. Screenshot-worthy. No Victoria. No animal required.

ru.headline: Говорит vs Слышишь
lines: Слышишь: «Я должна согреть его и подождать»

en.headline: Says vs You Hear
lines: Says: "Work is crazy, don't want complications"
You hear: "I need to be patient and warm him up"

per_panel_scene_hints.scene: SAVE CARD. Layered framed card like slide-04 meaning-depth: Говорит / Слышишь / Реальность. Three stacked bands or pills. Screenshot-worthy. No Victoria.

ru.headline: 3 правила возвращения опоры
lines: 1. Суди по средней температуре, не по пикам
2. Сделал шаг назад — оставайся на месте

en.headline: 3 rules of self-grounding
lines: 1. Measure the baseline, not weekend peaks
2. When he steps back, stay where you are
3. Never warm up someone choosing the cold

per_panel_scene_hints.scene: SAVE CARD. Framed numbered checklist 1–3 in magenta/white pills. Clean, bookmarkable. No Victoria. No cute extra pets.

ru.headline: Ясность вместо дежурства
ru.body: Отношения строятся на стабильности, а не на качелях. Твой человек не заставит гадать о своих чувствах.

en.headline: Clarity over constant waiting
en.body: Real connection brings stability, not an emotional roller coaster. The right person never leaves you guessing.
